answer: Assign every job by verifiable lottery instead of letting agents choose: each identity receives unpredictable work with a short deadline, and missing it burns its bond. A Sybil farm cannot steer its fakes toward easy profitable tasks, and one operator cannot finish a gale of simultaneous assignments. Each completed job leaves an ember of standing that fades without fresh work, while a single missed deadline sends a ripple of distrust to the identity's endorsers, who lose a slice of their own stake.
